# SimpleTooltip

```ts
import { SimpleTooltip } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Simple Tooltip provides a short, supplemental text description (Figma node 128:8606). Use it to clarify an unfamiliar control or truncated label. Keep it brief and non-interactive; use Rich Tooltip when the surface needs a title, actions, or structured guidance.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `trigger` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | Non-interactive trigger content rendered inside Radix Tooltip's real button. Do not pass another button here because nested controls are invalid. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | Tooltip text or short phrasing content. |
| `triggerAriaLabel` | `string` | — | Accessible name for a trigger whose visible content is not descriptive. |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Controlled open state. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial state for uncontrolled usage. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — | Fires whenever Radix opens or closes the tooltip. |
| `delayDuration` | `number` | `0` | Hover/focus delay before opening, in milliseconds. |
| `side` | `'top' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'left'` | `'top'` | Preferred placement relative to the trigger. |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'` | `'center'` | Alignment along the selected side. |
| `sideOffset` | `number` | `8` | Gap between trigger and tooltip. |
| `maxWidth` | `number \| string` | `280` | Maximum tooltip width (number = px). |


## Usage

```tsx
<SimpleTooltip trigger="Info">Explains this setting</SimpleTooltip>
<SimpleTooltip trigger="Keyboard shortcuts" side="bottom">Press Ctrl + K</SimpleTooltip>
<SimpleTooltip trigger={<InfoIcon />} triggerAriaLabel="About storage">Stored locally</SimpleTooltip>
<SimpleTooltip trigger="Long label" maxWidth={200}>A longer explanation that wraps.</SimpleTooltip>
<SimpleTooltip trigger="Delayed" delayDuration={500}>Opens after half a second</SimpleTooltip>
```

## Accessibility

- Radix connects the tooltip to its trigger with aria-describedby and opens it for both pointer hover and keyboard focus.
- If trigger content is only an icon, provide triggerAriaLabel so the button itself has an accessible name.
- Tooltip content must remain supplemental and non-interactive. Links, buttons, and required instructions belong in Rich Tooltip or persistent page content.
- Escape dismisses the surface, and reduced-motion preferences disable its entrance animation.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Explain unfamiliar icons or concise terms. | Repeat a visible, self-explanatory label. |
| Keep copy short enough to scan without interaction. | Put paragraphs, links, or actions inside. |
| Provide an accessible name for icon-only triggers. | Assume the tooltip text names the trigger action. |
| Place required instructions visibly in the page. | Hide critical information behind hover. |
